license_constraints: adapter itself has zero hard runtime dependency on nilearn/fmriprep -- it consumes lightweight fMRIPrep-style metadata (JSON/TSV) and user-provided derived feature tables/graph-summary JSON (CSV/JSON) with the Python standard library only; nilearn remains an optional, already permissive_low (BSD-3-Clause) dependency per external_tools/registry_seed.json if a future v2 ingests real Nilearn objects directly; fmriprep remains external_cli/planned (Apache-2.0, FreeSurfer sub-license not verified) and is never a hard adapter dependency
limitations: Consumes lightweight fMRIPrep-style metadata (dataset_description.json, participants.tsv, *_desc-confounds_timeseries.tsv, derivative JSON sidecars) and explicit user-provided derived feature tables/graph-summary JSON only -- does not read raw BOLD NIfTI files and does not run fMRIPrep or fit Nilearn models.

Requires an explicit, human-authored mapping (or self-contained graph-summary document) declaring source_state/target_state/modality='fMRI'/atlas_or_parcellation (for graph/connectivity features)/canonical feature names/definitions/confound_policy; never infers state labels, atlas identity, or feature identity from column names, file paths, or parcel counts.

Cohort-level (record_level='cohort') TransitionRecordV1 output requires an explicit, already-computed cohort.subject_count>=2 and cohort.metrics in the graph-summary input -- this adapter never computes cohort statistics itself.
Does not itself ingest raw fMRIPrep derivatives, Nilearn NiftiMasker/connectome objects, or MOABB/EEGDash datasets -- see docs/fmri_derivatives_adapter.md's Future Work section.

license_constraints: adapter itself has zero hard runtime dependency on mne/mne_bids -- it consumes lightweight BIDS metadata (JSON/TSV) and user-provided derived feature tables (CSV/JSON) with the Python standard library only; mne/mne_bids remain optional, already permissive_low (BSD-3-Clause) dependencies per external_tools/registry_seed.json if a future v2 ingests real MNE objects directly
limitations: Consumes lightweight BIDS metadata (dataset_description.json, participants.tsv, events.tsv) and explicit user-provided derived feature tables only -- does not read raw EEG/MEG/iEEG/fNIRS signal files and does not run MNE preprocessing.
Requires an explicit, human-authored mapping file declaring source_state/target_state/modality/canonical feature names/definitions; never infers state labels from column names or file paths.
Emits subject-level (record_level='subject') TransitionRecordV1 records only -- cohort-level records require real cohort statistics this v1 does not compute.
Does not itself ingest raw MNE Raw/Epochs objects, MOABB/EEGDash datasets, or live BrainFlow/MNE-LSL streams -- see docs/mne_bids_adapter.md's Future Work section.

license_constraints: dataset_importers.moabb_importer has zero hard runtime dependency on moabb -- it consumes lightweight fixture JSON with the Python standard library only; moabb (BSD-3-Clause, permissive_low, current_status=planned/not yet a declared dependency per external_tools/registry_seed.json) is only imported, optionally, for best-effort installed-package introspection that never calls .get_data()/.download()
limitations: This adapter produces DatasetCandidateRecordV1 scouting records only -- it never produces TransitionRecordV1/PhaseSpaceCoordinateV1/EvidenceBundleV1/EvidenceReportV1 artifacts, and a candidate record is never treated as evidence.
moabb is not installed in every environment this repository runs in; the installed-package introspection path is best-effort and falls back to a clear error if the package is unavailable.

license_constraints: dataset_importers.eegdash_importer has zero hard runtime dependency on eegdash -- it consumes lightweight fixture JSON with the Python standard library only; eegdash (BSD-3-Clause, permissive_low, already declared in requirements.txt and importable this session as eegdash==0.8.4) is only imported, optionally, for a metadata-only catalog query (eegdash.EEGDash.find_datasets, documented by the package itself as transferring no signal bytes) which defaults to off (live_query=False) and is never invoked by this repository's tests or CLI default paths
limitations: This adapter produces DatasetCandidateRecordV1 scouting records only -- it never produces TransitionRecordV1/PhaseSpaceCoordinateV1/EvidenceBundleV1/EvidenceReportV1 artifacts, and a candidate record is never treated as evidence.
The installed-package live-query path requires network access and is opt-in only (live_query=True / CLI --allow-live-query); its default behavior performs no network I/O at all.
